title: P.1 Review of Real Numbers

icans: I can write intervals in interval notation and as inequalities.
I can use absolute value to find distance on the real number line.

vocab: a number that can be written as a ratio p/q of ___________, q ≠ 0
a __________ number that is not rational
a way to write a set of real numbers with brackets and ______________
a ___________ distance from 0 on the real number line
